entities.summary: Nicolas Jean-François Emmanuel Le Goff is a French professional volleyball player who plays as a middle blocker for Montpellier Volley and the France national team. Le Goff won a gold medal in the men's tournament at the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024.
